memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow Me.” — Matthew 16:24

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
A self-centered, luxurious lifestyle can slowly drain a believer of spiritual power. One who perceived this clearly was Dr. R. A. Torrey, the associate of D. L. Moody and a renowned Bible teacher.
He writes plainly:
Spiritual power is lost through indulgence in selfish desires. Anyone who desires to experience the power of God must choose a life of self-denial. Dr. Torrey did not believe that a person could live in luxury, continually gratify natural appetites, indulge excessively in rich and pleasant foods, and at the same time experience the fullness of God’s power.
The gratification of the flesh and the fullness of the Holy Spirit do not walk hand in hand. If we desire to continually experience the power of the Holy Spirit, we must live a simple life, refusing excessive indulgence in selfish desires. True discipleship means being willing “to endure hardship as a good soldier of Jesus Christ” 
(2 Timothy 2:3).
Torrey speaks with striking honesty:
“Luxury frightens me. Though I do not fear it as I fear sin, next to sin it is the thing that frightens me most. It is the subtle and powerful enemy of spiritual power.”
Even today, some demons do not leave except through prayer and fasting. Spiritual power is never found in cheap living; it is born only through sacrifice.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “Luxury is the most subtle enemy of the power of God.”  Dr. R. A. Torrey

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, remove my self from the throne of my heart and make You the center of my life.
Deliver me from the bondage of comfort and luxury, and fill me with the power of the Holy Spirit.
Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Power is not born in comfort; it is formed in the shadow of the Cross. The Holy Spirit chooses to dwell where self is denied. He must increase, and you must decrease. May your life burn wholly for Him.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: Ablaze for God
recommended_book.author: Wesley L. Duewel
recommended_book.quote: In this book, the author emphasizes that a life burning for God is not produced by comfort or convenience, but by spiritual power forged in the fire of sacrifice. He clearly teaches that without prayer and fasting, one cannot experience the deeper realities of God.
